verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents first-party natural-language operation. Users can ask questions in plain language and Amplitude AI answers across their data (docs-10), or hold a conversation that returns expert-level answers without SQL or dashboard setup (docs-34). An official MCP server brings this into Claude, Cursor, OpenAI and other AI tools (docs-11, probe-4). Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can take actions (e.g. create charts, cohorts or flags) rather than only answer questions, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the AI answers work well.
